== Description ==

[[Greg Shaw]] (left) playing [[Patrick Johnson]] (right, grey X-wing T-shirt), with [[Spencer Gosiaco]] (centre, black Mariners cap and black hoodie) watching at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 5 October 2025; background faces unlabeled.
